name: Mary Susan Adams (Jones)
notable_stories: Mary Susan and her brother Charles both ended up under psychiatric care. She is listed as a patient at 'The Retreat' in Des Moines in the 1930 census, and was probably a resident there by 1925 since her husband was then living alone in a boarding house; it is unclear whether she was ever released.
milestones: Died 3 Dec 1943, Des Moines, Boone, IA
Reeves is listed as divorced in the 1930 census
Married Reeves H. Jones (m. 24 May 1899, Chariton County, Missouri)
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
